A note from the founder

“Good Thing has always been about people as much as it is about food. The Guest Chef Series is our way of opening the kitchen to voices we admire — chefs who cook with intention, who carry a place and a story in every dish they put on the table.

Beirut deserves that. A city that has always known how to sit together, eat well, and make something out of nothing. We built this series for those evenings — the ones you don’t forget.

Welcome to our table.”
Omar Jheir
Founder, Good Thing

01 / 07 Yucatecan

Luis

May 27 — 30, 2026

"Where the Yucatán Peninsula meets classical France — in every single bite."

Born in Mérida, Yucatán, Luis spent 12 years forging deep ties with local fishermen and the bold flavors of the peninsula. A chapter as gastronomic advisor at Les 500 Diables in France gave his cooking its classical backbone — fused now with the rooted, sun-drenched spirit of Yucatecan cuisine.

02 / 07 Mexican

Dani

June 24 — 27, 2026

"Born in Oaxaca. Trained in Mexico City. Arrived in Beirut with fire and mole and no intention of holding back."

Daniele builds menus that trace the full arc of Mexican cuisine — from the ancient to the radical. Fire-centered, smoke-forward, and unapologetically bold, her cooking draws on Oaxacan mole traditions, Yucatán street culture, and a decade spent refining technique in Mexico City's top kitchens.

Booking opens soon
03 / 07 Japanese

Philipp

August 2026

"Twenty years of obsessive study — and a lightness of touch that takes a lifetime to earn."

Philipp spent two decades mastering Japan's most meditative culinary traditions — kaiseki in Kyoto, fermentation studies in Osaka, ramen craft in Fukuoka. His menus are quiet, precise, and deeply considered.

Booking opens soon
04 / 07 Spanish

Robert

August 2026

"Spain distilled — sun, salt, fire, and a lifetime of knowing when to stop."

Robert brings the full breadth of Spanish regional cooking to one table — from the pintxos bars of San Sebastián to the wood-fire grills of Castilla. Technique in service of instinct. Nothing wasted, nothing missing.

Booking opens soon
05 / 07 Norwegian

Joanne

Sep 6 — 13, 2026

"Rooted in the Norwegian landscape — every ingredient carries the memory of where it came from."

Raised on a farm in Norway, Joanne learned to cook before she learned to talk about it. Her cooking is honest, seasonal, and deeply Nordic: foraged herbs, cold-water fish, root vegetables pulled that morning.

Booking opens soon
06 / 07 Nordic

Bjorn

October 2026

"Only what the season offers. Only what the land can give. A dinner that asks you to slow down."

From the forests and coastlines of Scandinavia, Chef Bjorn arrives with a philosophy of radical restraint. His menus are built entirely around what is available — cured, fermented, smoked, and preserved with the quiet intensity that defines the Nordic table.

Booking opens soon
07 / 07 Levantine

Ben

November 2026

"Levantine flavours rooted in memory — cooked with the precision of someone who never forgot where they came from."

Chicago-based Ben has built his career around the soul food of the Levant. As Executive Chef of Fiya — and before that at Michelin-listed SIFR — he refined a cooking language that honours Middle Eastern heritage without nostalgia.
